description.narrative: The youth leader exchange will support the implementation of two projects: 1) a CISU-funded project implemented by Kenya Red Cross (KRCS) and Danish Red Cross Youth (DRCY) focusing on capacitating youth to take lead on community development and 2) a Danish International Development Agency (DANIDA)-funded Urban Community Resilience Building (UCRB) project focusing on building long-term resilience for the most vulnerable communities in urban informal settlements. The two projects are implemented in Mukuru and Mathare informal settlements in Nairobi, with approximately 930,000 residents of which the vast majority are young people under 30 years. The informal settlements are highly underdeveloped with widespread poverty, insecurity, limited livelihood opportunities and access to social services. The YLEP will support the projects by strengthening the capacity of core KRCS youth volunteers to support local youth in Mukuru and Mathare to carry out relevant youth sessions, advocacy initiatives and awareness raising activities as well as raise their voice on youth issues.
